name: Spell Assistant
body:
You have a knack for helping others with their spellcasting.

Prerequisite: Accursed Blood, changeling, ability to cast 1st level spells

Benefit: You may use the aid another action to grant an adjacent ally a +2 circumstance bonus on caster level checks and concentration checks until the beginning of your next turn. The ally must remain adjacent to you to gain this benefit.

Normal: You may not use the aid another action to assist on caster level or concentration checks.
